artifactType: standalone mixed-source native dual-map run summary

conditions.sourceIdentityConfirmedBy: visible UI control labels; no source identifiers retained

javaHeapUsedMiB.tupleRule: legacy committed/free/committed bounds only; GC overlap was not observable, so not an atomic or proven GC-free snapshot

hwui.scope: Android Window FrameMetrics/HWUI only; not WorldWind GL/GPU time or FPS

contourAssembly.source: numeric contour telemetry from saved phase/loop checkpoints

logcat.mainThreadGcAttributionRule: Linux main-thread TID equals resolved process PID; raw identifiers omitted

limitations: This two-loop mixed-source run is standalone and is not combined with the four-loop paired comparison.
Java heap peaks include only valid same-sample tuples; inconsistent reads are not heap-limit or OOM evidence.
Shared render cache is identity-deduplicated and never summed across map windows.
PSS includes non-Java and shared-process accounting; subtracting Java heap does not identify a specific native allocation source.
GC/crash counts are limited to the captured sample window and resolved target app process; missing or incomplete logs are not a zero-event pass.
HWUI FrameMetrics are not WorldWind GL/GPU time or FPS; native frame-counter deltas are output counts only.
MuMu controlled evidence does not establish physical-phone behavior or unique crash causality.
Historical Java heap tuples did not record ART GC count before/after; committed/free/committed checks do not prove that no GC overlapped the read or form an atomic VM snapshot.

javaHeapSamplingConsistency.interpretation: Historical valid/bounded Java heap tuples required stable committed size and used bounds, but did not bracket the read with ART GC count. A GC between freeMemory and the second totalMemory could not be identified; these readings are observational bounds, not atomic or proven GC-free tuples.
